data.notes: February 2026 in São Paulo was anchored by Carnival programming and several large international touring concerts, with electronic and Latin-pop events standing out alongside stadium-scale rock and reggaeton.

events.title: Hermanos Gutiérrez — Queremos!
events.summary: Queremos! brought Ecuadorian-Swiss instrumental duo Hermanos Gutiérrez to Teatro Bradesco in São Paulo on 4 February 2026 before a Rio date the following night.

events.title: NAVE D-EDGE SP
events.summary: D-EDGE’s NAVE night listed Lary Lima, Perote, Fel C, Gui Boendia, Di Domenico, Juliana Mendez and Jhonny Sanchez across the club’s rooms from late 7 February into the morning of 8 February.

events.title: Ensaios da Anitta 2026 — São Paulo
events.summary: Anitta’s pre-Carnival touring party reached Mercado Livre Arena Pacaembu with listed guests including Pabllo Vittar, Marina Sena, Dennis, Nattan, Felipe Amorim and Viviane Batidão.

events.title: Kali Uchis — The Sincerely, Tour
events.summary: Kali Uchis played Vibra São Paulo on 8 February 2026 as part of The Sincerely, Tour, with the event listed for a 20:30 start.

events.title: Carnaval de São Paulo 2026 — Grupo Especial Parades
events.summary: São Paulo’s official Carnival Grupo Especial samba-school parades took place at the Sambódromo do Anhembi on 13 and 14 February 2026, with the city publishing the full running order and times.

events.title: Bloco da Pabllo with NMIXX
events.summary: Pabllo Vittar’s Carnival bloco in São Paulo featured K-pop group NMIXX as a special guest on 16 February 2026, a notable crossover moment for the city’s street-Carnival calendar.

events.title: Bad Bunny — DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS World Tour
events.summary: Bad Bunny played two São Paulo dates at Allianz Parque on 20 and 21 February 2026, with the Ticketmaster page listing both performances for the stadium event.

events.title: AC/DC — Power Up Tour
events.summary: AC/DC’s official Power Up Tour announcement listed São Paulo’s Estádio do MorumBIS for 24 February 2026, part of the band’s large 2026 stadium run.

events.title: Macy Gray — Turnê de Verão 2026
events.summary: Macy Gray’s Brazil tour included a São Paulo concert at Cine Joia on 25 February 2026, with the show focused on her album On How Life Is and career hits.

events.title: RÜFÜS DU SOL — São Paulo
events.summary: RÜFÜS DU SOL played Mercado Livre Arena Pacaembu on 27 February 2026, bringing their electronic live show to São Paulo after a Curitiba date earlier in the week.

events.title: AC/DC — Power Up Tour
events.summary: Live Nation listed AC/DC at Estádio MorumBIS on 28 February 2026, with The Pretty Reckless billed as the opening act and AC/DC scheduled for 21:00.
